englishSource: Facilitator training video — for in-person sessions, not for streaming here.
rootCandidate: Video ya thupelo ya facilitators — ke ya mananeo ao batho ba kopanang ka seqo ho ona; ha se ya streaming mona.
backTranslation: A facilitator training video — it is for sessions where people meet in person; it is not for streaming here.
semanticCheck: Preserves the facilitator-training-video purpose, the in-person session condition, and the local “not for streaming here” limitation. “Streaming” remains a technical English term as permitted. It does not claim that all online playback is prohibited.
uncertainty: Confirm with a Sesotho speaker that the facilitator loan and “mananeo ao batho ba kopanang ka seqo ho ona” are natural; no language/fluency approval is implied.
